consts.name: lycProgressRows
consts.comment: the lycanthrope experience grid - ten levels (folio 32, PDF 34)

consts.name: lycBiteCatchPercent
consts.comment: characters bitten by lycanthropes have a 50 percent chance of catching the condition (folio 29)

consts.name: lycOnsetMinDays
consts.comment: the first shape-change occurs in 30-60 days, the floor (folio 29)

consts.name: lycOnsetMaxDays
consts.comment: the onset ceiling, 30-60 days (folio 29)

consts.name: lycFirstChangePanicPercent
consts.comment: at the first transformation the animal nature predominates on a 95 percent chance, resulting in blind panic (folio 29)

consts.name: lycSubjugationPercent
consts.comment: a 10 percent chance the shock causes insane subjugation of the human persona to the animal nature, persisting until cured as an insanity (folio 29)

consts.name: lycSleepRevertPercent
consts.comment: an exhausted lycanthrope sleeping has about a 5 percent chance of reverting to human form, undependable, higher under extreme exhaustion or severe wounds (folio 30)

consts.name: lycRevertWillXp
consts.comment: a new lycanthrope cannot revert to human form at will until 2500 experience points gained beyond the pre-infection total, the grid level-2 figure (folio 30)

consts.name: lycVoluntaryChangesPerDay
consts.comment: a lycanthrope may transform only once per day on his own (folio 30)

consts.name: lycInducedChangeRestDays
consts.comment: a more experienced lycanthrope may induce a second shapechange in another, requiring a full day of rest and no more than once per day (folio 30)

consts.name: lycFighterExampleLevel
consts.comment: the article worked example - a fourth-level fighter contracting lycanthropy (folio 30)

consts.name: lycFighterExampleHitDice
consts.comment: the worked-example lycanthrope initially fights as a monster of four hit dice in wereshape, unless the Blackmoor modifications are in effect (folio 30)

consts.name: lycExampleChangeRounds
consts.comment: the worked example - a low-level werebear taking six rounds to change fully (folio 32)

consts.name: lycRoundTwoPenalty
consts.comment: the worked example combat ladder - round two at level minus two (folio 32)

consts.name: lycRoundThreePenalty
consts.comment: the ladder - rounds three and four at minus four (man and bear respectively), recovering to minus two at round five and full bear at round six, half damage from normal weapons at the halfway point (folio 32)

consts.name: lycCuredXpPercent
consts.comment: magic-users, clergy or psychics cured after some time as a lycanthrope apply only 50 percent of the experience earned during that period (folio 32)

consts.name: lycHereditaryChanceMin
consts.comment: the further option - new characters a 1-5 percent chance of beginning as a hereditary lycanthrope, humans only, the floor (folio 32)

consts.name: lycHereditaryChanceMax
consts.comment: the hereditary-chance ceiling, 1-5 percent (folio 32)

consts.name: lycJarnkungAc
consts.comment: the Jarnkung armor class 3 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungMoveInches
consts.comment: the Jarnkung move 9 inches (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungHitDice
consts.comment: the Jarnkung hit dice 5 - the cell prints the =) bar garble in the djvu OCR and resolves at the full-res scan to 5, the R919 one-visual-check precedent, noted never silent (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungLairPercent
consts.comment: the Jarnkung 15 percent in lair (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungMagicResistance
consts.comment: the Jarnkung magic resistance 20 percent (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungAppearingMin
consts.comment: the Jarnkung number appearing 1-6, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungAppearingMax
consts.comment: the appearance ceiling, 1-6, or 2-12 in lair (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungLairAppearingMin
consts.comment: the in-lair number appearing 2-12, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungLairAppearingMax
consts.comment: the in-lair ceiling, 2-12 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungTailDamageMin
consts.comment: the Jarnkung tail does 2-12 points, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungTailDamageMax
consts.comment: the tail ceiling, 2-12, or two weapons by weapon type (folio 3)

consts.name: lycJarnkungWizardYearsAgo
consts.comment: the Jarnkung origin - a lonely wizard created them about 250 years ago to watch his keep (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerMoveFeetPerTurn
consts.comment: the Cursed Crimson Crawler move 60 feet per turn, the unit as printed, noted (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerHdEights
consts.comment: the Crawler hit dice print the prose "3 eight sided + 1 four sided = 3 1/2" - three d8, the fraction garbled to 3% in the djvu OCR and resolved at the full-res scan (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerHdFours
consts.comment: the Crawler hit dice - one d4 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerHdHalves
consts.comment: the Crawler hit-dice total 3 1/2 pinned in halves as 7, the conversion noted (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerAc
consts.comment: the Cursed Crimson Crawler armor class 7 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerAttacks
consts.comment: the Crawler makes 2 attacks (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerDamageMin
consts.comment: the Crawler close combat does 1-6 points per attack, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerDamageMax
consts.comment: the Crawler damage ceiling, 1-6 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerRockDamageMin
consts.comment: the Crawler throws heavy rocks doing 1-12 points, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerRockDamageMax
consts.comment: the rock ceiling, 1-12 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerRockRangeFeetPerHp
consts.comment: the rock range is 10 feet per hit point of the Crawler (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerRageRadiusFeet
consts.comment: the Crawler death-burst - all within 30 feet become enraged at each other (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerRageMinRounds
consts.comment: the rage lasts 1-4 melee rounds, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycCrawlerRageMaxRounds
consts.comment: the rage ceiling, 1-4 melee rounds (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikAc
consts.comment: the Ulik armor class 4 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikMoveInches
consts.comment: the Ulik movement 14 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikHitDice
consts.comment: the Ulik hit dice 4 plus 2 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikHitDicePlus
consts.comment: the Ulik hit-dice plus, 4+2 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikLairPercent
consts.comment: the Ulik 20 percent in lair, treasure type I (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikAppearingMin
consts.comment: the Ulik number appearing 1-6, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikAppearingMax
consts.comment: the appearance ceiling, 1-6 (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikHypnotizeSurprisedPercent
consts.comment: the Ulik pupiless white eyes hypnotize a surprised victim on 90 percent (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikHypnotizeAwarePercent
consts.comment: the hypnotize chance against a non-surprised victim, 50 percent (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikTailBlowMin
consts.comment: the tender tail growth serves as a mace for 10-40 blows before falling off, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikTailBlowMax
consts.comment: the tail-mace ceiling, 10-40 blows (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikTailRegrowMinMonths
consts.comment: the fallen growth regenerates after 6-8 months, the floor (folio 3)

consts.name: lycUlikTailRegrowMaxMonths
consts.comment: the regeneration ceiling, 6-8 months (folio 3)

bools.name: lycAbilityLossProgressive
bools.comment: over the incubation the victim suffers a proportional loss of all magical, clerical or psychic ability, complete at the first transformation (folio 29)

bools.name: lycChildrenInheritCondition
bools.comment: children of uncured lycanthropes inherit the condition, transmitted only via the bloodstream and not via intercourse (folio 30)

bools.name: lycFirstTransformationAtPuberty
bools.comment: hereditary werebears not raised among their own kind have their first transformation at the onset of puberty (folio 30)

bools.name: lycAnimalShapeSterile
bools.comment: lycanthropes in animal shape are sterile as regards normal animals of the same type (folio 30)

bools.name: lycNoHumanSpeechInAnimalShape
bools.comment: lycanthropes may not speak human languages in animal shape, though they understand those they know (folio 30)

bools.name: lycNoHumanWeaponsInAnimalShape
bools.comment: the wereshape cannot use standard weapons or human equipment including rods; passive magic items work if retained, most potions fail, poison works (folio 30)

bools.name: lycWereratPoisonSaveReduced
bools.comment: rats lack a vomit reflex, so the wereshaped wererat saving throw against ingested poisons should be reduced (folio 30)

bools.name: lycCureDiseaseOrCureLycanthropyPermanent
bools.comment: a clerical cure disease or a healing cure lycanthropy cast upon the subject in animal form results in permanent loss of the disease and reversion to human form (folio 30)

bools.name: lycCuredRecoveryTimeEqualsLossTime
bools.comment: cured magic-users, clergy or psychics need the same amount of time to recover lost abilities as the disease took to lose them (folio 32)

bools.name: lycWerebearMostUsableForPCs
bools.comment: werebears are the most usable type for player characters, the others less able to control their beastly natures (folio 30)

bools.name: lycNpcWerebearsUsuallyLawful
bools.comment: non-player werebears are usually lawful and extremely reluctant to contribute to the spread of the disease (folio 30)

bools.name: lycArmorDoesNotVanish
bools.comment: clothing and armor do not disappear and reappear at a shapechange - it must be shed, loose fabrics advised over metal (folio 30)

bools.name: lycTransformationNotInstantaneous
bools.comment: the change from man to beast is not instantaneous, the time reducing with experience (folio 32)

bools.name: lycThievesMayBenefit
bools.comment: thieves function as fighters in this regard and are the only other class where lycanthropy may prove a positive asset (folio 32)

bools.name: lycRangersFunctionAsFighters
bools.comment: rangers function as fighters but cannot gain any holy or magic powers while the disease persists (folio 32)

bools.name: lycBardsLoseCharisma
bools.comment: bards suffer a loss of charisma over the long haul - hairiness, pointed teeth, animal odor, raw meat, the shape changes - the charm chances somewhat reduced (folio 32)

bools.name: lycClericTurnUndeadMayHalve
bools.comment: the cleric's ability to turn undead may at the DM option be reduced by half, as with psionics, or retained fully (folio 32)

bools.name: lycJarnkungMagicWeaponsOnly
bools.comment: the Jarnkung are only affected by magic weapons, highly intelligent (folio 3)

bools.name: lycJarnkungEspRumoredPsionics
bools.comment: the Jarnkung have ESP, the older ones rumored to use psionic powers (folio 3)

bools.name: lycCrawlerHatredBurstOnDeath
bools.comment: the Crawler spiked tail knob bursts its pent-up hatred if the monster is killed, saving throws as against poison, those saved still attackable by the cursed (folio 3)

bools.name: lycUlikHypnoticEyes
bools.comment: the Ulik rear up from hiding, the hypnotic eyes working on the surprised (folio 3)

bools.name: lycUlikTailGrowthFallsOff
bools.comment: the Ulik tail growth is very tender and after 10-40 blows falls off, regenerating after 6-8 months (folio 3)

bools.name: lycContestWinnersThree
bools.comment: the Name That Monster Contest #1 winners printing in full - the Jarnkung the winner, the Cursed Crimson Crawler the first runner-up, the Ulik the second runner-up, the stats deferred from the issue-13 names-only list (folio 3)
